summary_en: Toyo Tire cancelled 30,672,200 shares on 30 September 2026 under the Companies Act. The cancellation reduced outstanding shares to 123,438,829.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Toyo Tire Corporation completed the cancellation of 30,672,200 treasury shares on 30 September 2026, pursuant to a resolution adopted by the Board of Directors on 7 August 2026 under Article 178 of the Companies Act. Following the cancellation, the total number of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock) became 123,438,829, with 249,337 shares remaining in treasury. The cancelled shares represented 19.9% of outstanding shares before cancellation.
